source.sourceLicense: MIT; include upstream LICENSE with redistributed outputs
source.treeTypeCaveat: Ash Large and Oak Large are author-defined procedural presets, not botanical surveys or Hudson-specific species models.
source.generatorBehavior: The author source creates a deterministic skeleton per preset seed; generateLODs/createGeometry mesh alternate levels from that same skeleton.

ash.mode: palette PNG with transparency; alpha extrema 0..255

oak.mode: palette PNG with transparency; alpha extrema 0..255

bark.set: AmbientCG Bark001 1K JPG: Color, NormalGL, Roughness
bark.license: CC0 1.0 (AmbientCG); upstream notice gives source and URLs

generation.heightPolicy: The preset source does not identify a physical unit or field-measured height. Export positions are uniformly scaled to an explicit 20m presentation height; that scale is an asset presentation choice, not a local measurement.
generation.lodGeometry: per-preset skeleton re-meshed by the upstream createGeometry(details); no tree RNG/skeleton regeneration between LODs
generation.export: Static GLB 2.0 files; leaf PNG is alpha MASK with cutoff 0.5 and double-sided material; PBR bark maps are embedded. No runtime tree generation or in-app geographic placement is included.

validation.sourceGeometryCounts: Counted from indexed Three.js BufferGeometry position/index arrays.
validation.staticPreviews: Rendered by Blender 4.0.2 Eevee using the same source geometry levels and embedded source textures; these are standalone comparison images, not Chill Window browser/GPU visual acceptance.
validation.glbImport: GLB headers and embedded buffer/accessor/image layouts were generated and size-checked; Blender's built-in glTF importer could not run in this container because its Python package dependency numpy is unavailable to Blender's bundled interpreter. Do not treat this as independent application-import validation.
